Describe the Bug

Sending a follow-up to an existing Cloud Agent / Background Composer from Cursor IDE (Glass / Agents Window) fails with a server-side internal error.

Request ID: 7b18afc4-08f1-4aa3-8693-976320b6b62c

Where does the bug appear (feature/product)?

Cloud Agent (GitHub, Slack, Web, Linear)

Describe the Bug

Created Cloud Project does not appear in the Projects left-nav sidebar. Creation seemed to succeed (coordinator/brief started), then the Project vanished from the list. After full quit/reopen I still only see 2 Projects; the third is missing. Renaming the visible Projects in the UI immediately reverts. Local Cursor state still shows the missing Project as active (with a background-composer workspace id), so it looks like an orphan: exists in local/cloud worker state but not listed in the Projects sidebar. This makes multi-Project setups unusable.

Steps to Reproduce

  1. In Cursor, open Projects (left nav) → New Project.
  2. Select a private GitHub repo and create the Project (paste a short project brief / seed).
  3. Confirm creation appears to succeed (coordinator / brief starts).
  4. Return to the Projects list / sidebar.
  5. Observe the new Project is missing (or appears briefly then disappears).
  6. Fully quit Cursor and reopen; check Projects again — still missing.
  7. Optionally: rename one of the remaining visible Projects — the name reverts immediately.

Expected Behavior

Every successfully created Cloud Project appears and stays visible in the Projects left-nav sidebar.
Rename either persists, or the UI does not offer rename if titles are server-owned / immutable.
Creating a Project must not leave an orphan that exists in local/cloud worker state but is missing from the sidebar.

Operating System

Windows 10/11

Version Information

Version: 3.20.21
VSCode/Electron commit: f09fca384ceca23f7bf21f9c23655b162641d740
OS: Windows 11 Pro (10.0.26200)
Arch: x64

N/A — this is a Projects sidebar / Cloud Projects listing bug, not a model-output issue.

bc-397431a7-931d-460f-bcc5-f6c7c1e65e93

Missing Project id:
47b65346-d08a-4cc7-90d8-5de685ee6f54

Additional Information

  • Only 2 of 3 created Cloud Projects appear in the Projects left-nav.
  • The missing Project was created successfully (coordinator/brief started), then vanished from the list; still missing after full quit/reopen.
  • Local glass.cloudAgentProjects.v1 still shows that Project as active with the worker id above.
  • Renaming the visible Projects in the UI immediately reverts.
  • Happening on Windows Cursor 3.20.21; Cloud Agents had a reported service degradation around the same time.
